facebookresearch_audiodec/trainer/traine.run_GAN_training: run the TrainerGAN training loop for generator and discriminator models with tensorboard logging
facebookresearch_audiodec/trainer/traine.save_GAN_checkpoint: save a GAN training checkpoint with generator and discriminator model states and optimizer states
facebookresearch_audiodec/trainer/traine.load_GAN_checkpoint: load a GAN training checkpoint to restore generator and discriminator models and training state
facebookresearch_audiodec/trainer/traine.compute_adversarial_loss: compute the adversarial loss with optional feature matching loss for the GAN generator
facebookresearch_audiodec/trainer/traine.compute_discriminator_loss: compute the discriminator loss combining real and fake prediction losses for the GAN discriminator
facebookresearch_audiodec/trainer/traine.compute_metric_loss: compute metric losses including mel spectrogram, multi-resolution STFT, and waveform shape losses
facebookresearch_audiodec/trainer/traine.update_generator: update the GAN generator model parameters using gradient descent with optional gradient clipping
facebookresearch_audiodec/trainer/traine.update_discriminator: update the GAN discriminator model parameters using gradient descent with optional gradient clipping
facebookresearch_audiodec/trainer/traine.run_VQGAN_training: run the TrainerVQGAN training loop with vector quantization loss and perplexity tracking
facebookresearch_audiodec/trainer/traine.compute_VQ_loss: compute and record the vector quantization loss with configurable lambda weighting for VQGAN training
facebookresearch_audiodec/trainer/traine.record_perplexity: record perplexity metrics for vector quantization codebook usage during VQGAN training
facebookresearch_audiodec/trainer/traine.evaluate_GAN_model: run evaluation on the development dataset and log averaged loss metrics to tensorboard
